title: Communal street minimum 12 m wide (20 or more potential lots)
text: Notwithstanding C3.7.13, where a proposed development has the potential to be subdivided to create 20 or more strata lots or survey-strata lots, with each lot obtaining driveway access from a communal street, the communal street shall be a minimum 12m wide, which shall include: i. a paved vehicular carriageway with a minimum width of 5.5m; ii. a 1.2m wide universally accessible pedestrian path; iii. soft landscaping of a minimum width 2.5m; and iv. lighting as required by the decision-maker.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies where the communal street serves 20 or more potential strata or survey-strata lots (site.communal_street_serves_lots, read as potential lots or dwellings each taking driveway access from the communal street). Greenfield in practice. Limbs (i)-(iii) are separate rules; limb (iv) 'lighting as required by the decision-maker' is a judgment and is not tested.
